groundingRules: CRITICAL: Use ONLY facts that appear in the siteFacts section below or in entities. Do NOT invent operational specifics, numbers, lane lists, dispatcher policies, fleet sizes, or service details. If a topic requires a fact not in siteFacts, write generically (industry-wide, not company-specific) or omit that detail.
When citing specific company numbers (pay percent, weekly pay, referral bonus, etc.), use the EXACT values from siteFacts — never approximate or substitute.
Owner operator pay is 80% of GROSS (linehaul) revenue — never write '90%' or '90% linehaul'. That figure is outdated.

Company driver pay is quoted as $2,300+/week ($104K–$120K/yr) with automatic raises every 75,000 miles. Do NOT use CPM / cents-per-mile figures for company drivers — the site deliberately avoids CPM language.

When referencing location, use 'Woodridge, IL (Chicago metro)' or 'Chicago-area' — not just 'Chicago'. HQ is 7501 Lemont Rd, Suite 200, Woodridge, IL 60517. The site also refers to itself broadly as a 'Chicago' carrier, so 'Chicago-area' is safe.
Lane specifics (which states / cities the company runs to): do NOT name specific lanes unless they appear in siteFacts.

Pay structure: owner operators keep 80% of gross linehaul revenue with transparent weekly settlements and zero hidden fees (no forced dispatch fees, no trailer rental fees, no ELD charges). Company drivers earn $2,300+/week starting with automatic raises. Don't invent alternative structures.

Equipment: the XXII Century trailer network is DRY VAN ONLY (drop & hook). Do NOT claim reefers or flatbeds as company equipment. Drivers can use XXII Century trailers or bring their own tractor (Power Only).
Always include the phone number 630-914-6037 in the closing CTA paragraph.

When citing facts that aren't about the company itself (fuel prices, regulations, industry trends), link to one of the approved externalLinks domains as the source. Do NOT invent statistics or cite unnamed 'experts/studies'.

entities.legalName: XXII Century Inc (operating as XXII Century Trucking)

siteFacts.ownerOperatorPay: Owner operators keep 80% of gross linehaul revenue on every load, with transparent weekly settlements and zero hidden fees. No forced dispatch fees, no trailer rental fees, no ELD charges.
siteFacts.companyDriverPay: Company drivers start at $2,300+/week ($104K–$120K/yr) with automatic raises every 75,000 miles. Full benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid vacation. Modern Volvo & Freightliner trucks, weekly pay, weekly home time.
siteFacts.topEarnings: Top owner operators average $8,000+/week gross. Owner operators average $300,000+ annually.
siteFacts.trailers: Large dry-van trailer network (drop & hook freight). Drivers can use XXII Century trailers or bring their own tractor. The trailer network is dry van only.
siteFacts.fuelProgram: Large fleet-volume fuel discounts at major truck stops nationwide (biggest fuel discount guaranteed). AI-powered fuel management tool to find the cheapest fuel on your route.
siteFacts.dispatchModel: No forced dispatch — you see the load, you see the rate, you decide. Flexible scheduling: customer (dedicated) lanes + open-board freight. Both regional Chicago-area and long-haul OTR available. 24/7 dispatch support.
siteFacts.freight: Fortune 500 freight partners. 97% on-time delivery rate.
siteFacts.powerOnlyProgram: Fleet owners and small carriers: Power Only program. Trailer provided by XXII Century, 24/7 dispatch, weekly pay. Requires Motor Carrier Authority, DOT Number, Auto Liability, Cargo Liability, and Non-Owned Trailer Interchange Insurance. Fleet program owner operators average $300,000+ annually.
siteFacts.referralBonus: $1,000 per qualified driver referral, unlimited (no cap).
siteFacts.applicationProcess: Apply online in roughly 5 minutes at intelliapp.driverapponline.com/c/goxxii?r=bodan, or call 630-914-6037. Recruiting typically responds within 1 hour; many drivers start within 48 hours.
siteFacts.freightServices: Nationwide FTL dry van shipping across all 48 contiguous states with a 97% on-time rate. Real-time GPS tracking, dedicated account management, asset-based capacity for shippers and brokers.
siteFacts.company: Founded 2009 in Woodridge, IL (Chicago metro). 17+ years in business, 100+ drivers, 4.8/5 across 127+ reviews. Asset-based Chicago CDL-A carrier hauling Fortune 500 freight.

ownerOperators.q: What percentage do owner operators keep at XXII Century?
ownerOperators.a: Owner operators keep 80% of gross linehaul revenue on every load. There are no forced dispatch fees, no trailer rental fees, and no ELD charges — what you earn stays in your pocket.

ownerOperators.q: Do I need my own trailer to be an owner operator?
ownerOperators.a: No. XXII Century offers a large dry-van trailer network. You can use our trailers or bring your own tractor.

ownerOperators.q: What fuel discounts are available for owner operators?
ownerOperators.a: We provide large fleet-volume fuel discounts at major truck stops nationwide. Our AI-powered fuel management tool helps you find the cheapest fuel on your route.

ownerOperators.q: Can I choose my own routes as an owner operator?
ownerOperators.a: Yes. We offer flexible scheduling with both customer (dedicated) lanes and open-board freight. Whether you prefer regional Chicago-area runs or long-haul OTR, we match loads to your preferences.

ownerOperators.q: Is there a referral bonus for owner operators?
ownerOperators.a: Yes — $1,000 per qualified driver referral, unlimited (no cap).

companyDrivers.q: How much do company drivers earn at XXII Century?
companyDrivers.a: Company drivers start at $2,300+/week ($104K–$120K/yr) with automatic raises every 75,000 miles, plus full benefits and weekly pay.
